title: Stainless Steel Kitchen Funnel, 4.3-Inch Food Grade Metal Funnel with Strainer for Filling Bottles, Transferring Liquid, Oil, Juice, Milk
description:
About this item
【Safe & Durable】The funnel is made of 100% Food grade 304 stainless steel with practical handle, long service life and safe for dishwasher.
【Easy to Clean and Store】With a smooth metal surface, the funnel and detachable strainer is easy to clean, hand washable and dishwasher safe. The ergonomic handle is easy to grip or hang in your kitchens, garages, or utility rooms.
【Detachable Strainer】Include a 304 stainless steel strainer, ideal for filling bottles and filtering hot cooking oil, grease or soup, etc. You can also separate the strainer and use it as a standard funnel to fill a pepper, spice, salt, jam, particulates, powder, etc.
【Quick Funnel】Heart-shaped stem air release channel allows the outflow of air in order to fill liquid faster.
【Compatible】Compatible for most bottles, jars and other containers. Perfect for transporting liquids quickly and accurately, rebottling, adding jams and marmalades to storage containers.
reviews_5s:
Well madeI made the mistake of leaving a plastic funnel in a container of hot grease which melted the end of the funnel. I was still able to use it, but came across this one, and I know that it won’t melt if I leave it sitting in hot grease!So far, we have always used plastic funnels in the everyday kitchen operations but, with the growing allergic problems developed by my wife with age we are trying to switch toward safer options.
In the case at hand, we opted for this small stainless steel funnel, mainly for the following reasons:
1) its composition. It is made in stainless steel that works and reacts (my personal opinion) much better than plastic when dealing with hot liquids like tea
2) it has a very fine strainer that locks on the bottom, via a simple spring system, avoiding undesiderable particles to deposit in the destination container. This is particularly appreciated by my wife, since she rips the tea bags (loosening the leaves) because heat releases a number of unwanted chemicals present in the afore-mentioned silk or whatever else bags
3) it is very easy to clean. Just extract the strainer and wash, removing attached particles
4)it is very pretty and looks nice on the little shelf that I have built for our common, easy to reach, everyday little kitchen gadgets
Other than that it arrived according to schedule; it is moderatly priced and, more importantly, my wife is so happy with it that I bought her bigger and different strainers (the kind with a larger "mouth") that she uses to fill jars but .... this is another storyComes with a little screen/filter that you can place inside funnel, handy addition. Eliminating plastics in the kitchen so tossed the plastic funnel for this one. Works perfectly and the screen comes in handy for juice filtering, etc.Works great for wide mouth mason jars and we are able to stack the larger funnel inside the smaller one to get soup more cleanly into a Stanley thermos. The smaller funnel fits well into the thermos opening and the larger one stacked on top allows for an easier (less precise) pour.Glad to have metal instead of plastic. Well designed.Of course, I used these for canning. They are perfect.Pros

Stainless steel, well manufactured and includes a cleaning brush and filter
there is a slight groove in the tube to allow air to escape, but its not deep enough for some bottles mouths and prevents air from equalizing as it fills
can't tell if its true SS 304 alloy but using a magnet its weaker pull than pure iron suggest it is 304, and the manufacture there are no traces of rust
it has been washed almost daily in a dishwasher for a month and it remains like new
I use it to transfer coffee, soda, water, cooking oil and vinegar

Cons
there was a film of grease on the funnel which did not clean out thoroughly with multiple soap or dishwashing. I finally cleaned it completely using 70% isopropanol until it left no residue on a paper towelGood quality, nice features including the strainer and cleaning brush.The hubby melted a plastic funnel one day making lard and I thought for all the kitchen projects we do, we should have a metal funnel. Found this and we're loving it. I especially like the removable strainer option! Recommend!
reviews_1s:
The inside diameter of the throat of the large funnel in this set is actually the same size as the inside diameter of the standard mouth funnel made by Ball, and the throat of the large funnel in this set is only about 1/2 inch long, vice 1 inch long on the Ball funnel. The effect of that is that the funnel is perched precariously in the jar, requiring you to hold the funnel while using it, instead of the funnel being fairly secure enough so that you can use both hands holding the item you are transferring to the jar. I was looking for the same performance on wide mouth jars that I have with the Ball funnel on standard jars. Not even taking these out of the plastic, sending them back. For people who use standard mouth jars, and have an extra hand to hold the funnel while you pour, this set should be OK.The air channel concave is not as pronounced as it is shown in the images. This is an issue because you have to lift the funnel while pouring, when the air channel should have prevented the need.I guess this is a partial review. Somehow a partial set - only the large funnel - was in my box. That one is ok, but I feel robbed.Only 1 of the 3 parts arrived and the part that was shipped was dirty and had hair inside of it.The pipe for the funnel is bent and pinched. The manufacturer's container is a filmsy white giftbox which offers no protection for the funnel. Very disappointing.Click to play video
The only thing received was a small strainer. Did not even include the funnel.Flimsy and lite metal. Dissatisfied.I need to get paid to doBent around the edges, but I kept it anyway.It’s not a 5 in. Now I’m stuck with it!
